source: 外研社选择性必修三 Unit 1 同主题完形(接受雀斑/停止网上比较/内在美演讲/穿衣表达自我/戒掉修图/奶奶的一课)。用词限本单元/常见词,答案唯一,选项同词性,与阅读/听力关不撞文章。

passages.title: Learning to Love My Freckles
passages.text: When I was younger, I hated the freckles on my face and thought they made me ugly. Every morning I would (1)____ at the mirror and wish they would disappear. I begged my mother to buy a cream that promised to (2)____ them, but nothing worked. For a long time this small thing really (3)____ me, and I avoided having my photo taken. Then one summer my art teacher told me that my freckles were (4)____, like tiny stars across my cheeks. Her words slowly changed the way I (5)____ myself. I began to (6)____ that a face without any marks would be rather boring. Now, instead of hiding, I feel (7)____ of my freckles. They are part of who I am, and they make me (8)____ from everyone else. I have learned an important (9)____: real beauty is not about having a perfect face. It is about being (10)____ with the face you already have.

questions.explanation: stare at the mirror 盯着镜子;其余动词不搭配。
remove the freckles 去掉雀斑。
really bothered me 让我苦恼。
freckles were beautiful 很美;形容词同类。
the way I saw myself 看待自己的方式。
began to realise 开始意识到。
feel proud of 为……自豪。
make me different from 与众不同。
an important lesson 一个重要的道理。
be happy with 对……满意;形容词同类。

passages.title: Stop Comparing
passages.text: Last year I spent far too much time on social media, and it slowly made me (1)____. Every day I would scroll through photos of people who seemed prettier, richer and more (2)____ than me. The more I looked, the worse I (3)____. I started to believe that my own life was dull and that I would never be good (4)____. One evening my best friend noticed how quiet I had become and asked what was (5)____. When I explained, she smiled and said that those perfect online lives are mostly not (6)____. People only post their best moments, she reminded me, and (7)____ their bad days. Her words helped me see the truth. I decided to (8)____ less time on my phone and more time with real friends. Bit by bit, I stopped (9)____ myself to strangers on a screen. Now I feel much more (10)____ about who I am.

questions.explanation: made me unhappy 让我不快乐;语境为负面。
more confident 更自信;形容词同类。
the worse I felt 我越难受。
good enough 够好。
what was wrong 出了什么问题。
not real 不真实;形容词同类。
hide their bad days 藏起糟糕的日子;与 'post their best moments' 形成对比。
spend less time 花更少时间;固定搭配 spend time。
stop comparing myself 停止比较。
more positive 更积极;形容词同类。

passages.title: A Speech on Inner Beauty
passages.text: Today I want to talk about something we often (1)____: inner beauty. Our world tells us again and again that looks come first. We are taught to (2)____ a lot about our faces, our weight and our clothes. Yet the people we truly (3)____ are seldom the prettiest ones. They are the kind, the honest and the (4)____. A warm smile and a caring heart leave a far deeper (5)____ than a perfect face ever could. Of course, I am not saying that appearance does not (6)____ at all. Looking neat and tidy can (7)____ our confidence and help us make friends. The problem begins when we let our looks (8)____ everything else. So my (9)____ to you is simple. Take care of your appearance, but spend even more energy becoming a person whose (10)____ shines from the inside. That is the kind of beauty that never fades.

questions.explanation: often overlook 常常忽视。
worry a lot about 非常担心。
the people we admire 我们敬佩的人。
the brave 勇敢的人;形容词作名词,与 kind/honest 并列。
leave a deeper impression 留下更深印象。
does not matter 不重要。
boost our confidence 增强自信。
let our looks decide everything 让外表决定一切。
my advice to you 我给你的建议。
whose beauty shines 美由内而外。

passages.title: Clothes That Say Who I Am
passages.text: For years I wore whatever everyone else wore, simply because I did not want to (1)____ out. If a certain style was popular, I bought it, even when it did not (2)____ me at all. Deep down, though, I felt like I was (3)____ to be someone I was not. Then a friend gave me a piece of (4)____ that changed things. She said that clothes can be a quiet way of (5)____ who you really are. So I began to choose pieces that I genuinely (6)____, rather than ones that were merely fashionable. To my surprise, dressing in my own style made me feel far more (7)____. People noticed the change, and a few even said I looked (8)____ than before. I learned that fashion is not about (9)____ everyone else. It is about letting your outside gently (10)____ the person you are inside.

questions.explanation: stand out 显得突出;此处不想引人注目。
did not suit me 不适合我。
pretending to be 假装成。
a piece of advice 一条建议。
a way of showing 展示……的方式。
pieces that I liked 我喜欢的衣服。
feel more comfortable 更自在;形容词同类。
looked happier 看起来更开心;形容词同类。
copying everyone else 模仿别人。
express the person you are 表达真实的你。

passages.title: Breaking the Editing Habit
passages.text: I used to edit every photo before I dared to post it. I would (1)____ my skin, brighten my eyes and make my face look thinner. At first it felt (2)____, but soon it became a heavy habit. I grew (3)____ that friends would meet me and find the real me less pretty than my pictures. The (4)____ between the two faces made me anxious. One day my younger brother looked at a photo and asked why I did not look like (5)____ in real life. His simple question really made me (6)____. I realised that I was teaching myself to (7)____ my own face. So I made a quiet (8)____ to stop. The first unedited photo was hard to share, but the comments were (9)____, and nobody minded my freckles at all. Little by little, I have learned to (10)____ the face I see in the mirror every morning.

questions.explanation: smooth my skin 把皮肤修平滑。
felt exciting 觉得新奇;形容词同类。
grew afraid that 越来越担心。
the difference between 两者的差别。
look like that 指代照片里的样子;代词单数指那张照片。
made me think 让我反思。
teaching myself to dislike 让自己讨厌自己的脸。
a quiet decision 一个决定。
comments were kind 评论很友善;形容词同类。
learned to accept 学会接受。

passages.title: Grandma's Lesson
passages.text: Whenever I felt sad about my looks, my grandmother had a gentle way of helping me. She would take my hand and (1)____ me a story from her own youth. As a girl, she had been teased for being too tall, and for years it (2)____ her greatly. But over time she came to (3)____ that her height was simply part of her. "The mirror," she once told me, "shows only your (4)____, never your heart." She believed that a kind word could leave a deeper (5)____ than the prettiest face. People might (6)____ you at first by your appearance, she said, but they remember you by your (7)____. Her own friends loved her not because she was (8)____, but because she was warm and honest. Those quiet talks taught me to (9)____ less about my reflection and more about the kind of person I wanted to (10)____. I still hear her gentle voice today.

questions.explanation: tell me a story 给我讲故事。
it troubled her greatly 让她非常苦恼。
came to accept 慢慢接受。
shows only your surface 只显示外表。
leave a deeper impression 留下更深印象。
judge you by your appearance 凭外表评判你。
remember you by your character 凭品格记住你。
not because she was pretty 不是因为漂亮;形容词同类。
worry less about 少在意。
the person I wanted to become 想成为的人。
